scope: Fixed exploratory representation canary selected after the existing-game audit. Both arms use identical F10 initialization, same balanced batches and old rehearsal, same sealed action law/Adam and2048 updates per seed. New847x64 input weights initialize to zero in both arms; control supplies zero extra features, candidate supplies public species/type/move metadata. Different active input capacity is part of the intervention; this does not isolate feature semantics from effective capacity. Previously used F16 development probe is reused; no fresh confirmation, full battles or policy promotion. No teacher logits, labels, rewards or private opponent information enter features. Nonzero semantic gradients also change the global clipping scale and Adam trajectory; this is a test of the entire additive input block, not an isolated causal test of semantics. Nominal type chart features omit ability/item/dynamic-move modifiers and are not simulator damage estimates.
